solution: The foci \((1,14)\) and \((1,-12)\) give the centre \((1,1)\) and \(be = 13\) along the vertical transverse axis, and the hyperbola passes through \((1,6)\), a vertex, so \(b = 5\). Then \(a^{2} = b^{2}\left(e^{2} - 1\right) = b^{2}e^{2} - b^{2} = 169 - 25 = 144\), and the length of the latus rectum is \(\frac{2a^{2}}{b} = \frac{2 \times 144}{5} = \frac{288}{5}\).
